Fremont.knock_hours: Not confirmed from ordinance text. City requires a Solicitor/Peddler permit (Ordinance No. 3970, Fremont Municipal Code ch. 10 art. 2, sec. 10-201/10-202) valid 30 days, carried on the solicitor's person. Permits can be revoked for after-hours operation, high-pressure sales, false info, or entering premises posted 'No Peddlers/Solicitors Allowed'.
Fremont.permit_note: FilthE already has this permit - no action needed. Renew every 30 days (Fremont PD, 725 N Park, 2nd floor).
Fremont.no_knock_list: No separate city no-knock registry found; posted 'No Soliciting/No Peddlers' signs on a property are enforced and can get a permit revoked if ignored.

Omaha.knock_hours: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM (peddler permit rules; 501(c)(3) nonprofits exempt from the permit, not the general public).
Omaha.permit_note: FilthE already has permits for this city - no action needed.
Omaha.no_knock_list: Not separately confirmed in this pass; assume posted 'No Soliciting' signs are respected as elsewhere in NE - verify with Omaha PD permit desk.
Omaha.source: https://permits.cityofomaha.org (Peddler Permit Municode summary); Omaha Municipal Code ch. 30 (Sales)

Lincoln.knock_hours: 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM, any day of the week (Lincoln Municipal Code ch. 5.36, Peddlers).
Lincoln.permit_note: FilthE already has permits for this city - no action needed. Permit (LMC 5.36) includes a background check; not valid over 1 year; must show permit to police or resident on request.
Lincoln.no_knock_list: City enforces posted 'No Soliciting' signs - solicitors must not approach those homes.
